stemMd:
An event has probability p, with 0<p<1.

Quantity A: p

Quantity B: 1−p
instructionsMd: Compare the two quantities using only the given information.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The relationship cannot be determined from the information given.

explanationMd: For p=0.2 the first quantity is smaller; for p=0.8 it is larger. Both are permitted probabilities, so no fixed relationship follows.
